Silver medal for Dwain Chambers Dwain Chambers impressively won the opening heat of the 60 metres and nearly five hours later looked even better as he ran a personal record equalling 6.55 in his semi final – a record he set eight years ago.
So said Dwain Chambers after winning his 60m semi-final at the European Indoor Championships at Turin, Italy, in the third fastest time in history.
